I opened the source and the quoted words are on it exactly. The candidate is still **out**: it gives no date or length of time (part 3), and whether he held a qualifying role at the time (part 1) is borderline.

**1. Page check: words found.** The web fetch returned the PDF and I extracted its text. It is the Collège de France press kit for LeCun's 2015–2016 chair. It contains his own essay, "Les Enjeux de la Recherche en Intelligence Artificielle", with the by-line "Yann LeCun, Directeur, Facebook AI Research; Professeur, New York University". The quoted passage is on the essay's sixth page, word for word. It follows the "gâteau au chocolat" and "matière noire" analogies and runs: "Tant que le problème de l'apprentissage non-supervisé ne sera pas résolu, nous n'aurons pas de machines vraiment intelligentes. C'est une question fondamentale scientifique et mathématique, pas une question de technologie. Résoudre ce problème pourra prendre de nombreuses années ou plusieurs décennies. A la vérité, nous n'en savons rien." This is his own essay, not news coverage. The press release is stamped "Février 2016" and the later pages "Janvier 2016". The essay mentions AlphaGo's win over the European champion, which was announced in late January 2016, so it was written in early 2016. The page gives no exact day.

**2. Admission rule:**
- **Part 1 (role): borderline.** In early 2016 he was Director of Facebook AI Research. He did not become Meta's Chief AI Scientist until about 2018. Running a lab inside Facebook is not plainly "chief executive, founder-leader or chair of a company" or "that company's named chief scientist". I can't say from the rule alone whether founding a lab counts as founder-leader.
- **Part 2 (forward-looking, about AI): passes, weakly.** It does say no truly intelligent machines until unsupervised learning is solved. But the time span is attached to solving a research problem, not directly to the machines.
- **Part 3 (date or length): fails.** "Nombreuses années ou plusieurs décennies" ("many years or several decades") names no length, the same as "a few years" under reading 3. He also adds "nous n'en savons rien" ("we don't know"). This is undated wording.
- **Part 4 (primary source): passes.** It is his own printed essay.
